:::{#exr-rss-hessian}
#### Second derivatives of RSS

Find the matrix of second derivatives of
$\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to $\intcoef$ and $\coef{x}$,
and show that it is positive definite when $S_{xx} > 0$ (@def-centered-sums).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-hessian}

Differentiate each first derivative again.
From @exr-rss-deriv-intercept,
$\partial \text{RSS} / \partial \intcoef = -2 n \bar{y} + 2 n \intcoef + 2 n \bar{x} \coef{x}$, so

$$
\frac{\partial^2 \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef^2} = 2n,
\qquad
\frac{\partial^2 \text{RSS}}{\partial \coef{x} \, \partial \intcoef} = 2 n \bar{x}.
$$

From @exr-rss-deriv-slope,
$\partial \text{RSS} / \partial \coef{x}
= -2 \sum_i x_i y_i + 2 \intcoef \sum_i x_i + 2 \coef{x} \sum_i x_i^2$, so

$$
\frac{\partial^2 \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef \, \partial \coef{x}} = 2 \sumin x_i = 2 n \bar{x},
\qquad
\frac{\partial^2 \text{RSS}}{\partial \coef{x}^2} = 2 \sumin x_i^2.
$$

So the matrix of second derivatives is

$$
2 \begin{pmatrix} n & n\bar{x} \\ n\bar{x} & \sumin x_i^2 \end{pmatrix}.
$$

Its top-left entry, $2n$, is positive.
Its determinant is

$$
\begin{aligned}
4 \paren{n \sumin x_i^2 - n^2 \bar{x}^2}
&= 4 n \paren{\sumin x_i^2 - n \bar{x}^2}
&& \text{(factor out $n$)}\\
&= 4 n S_{xx}
&& \text{($\sum_i (x_i - \bar{x})^2 = \sum_i x_i^2 - n \bar{x}^2$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

which is positive when $S_{xx} > 0$.
A symmetric $2 \times 2$ matrix with a positive top-left entry
and a positive determinant is positive definite.

:::
